gen_risks.description: ADISA and MIPA lack prior experience with World Bank fiduciary and procurement guidelines, creating a risk of procurement bottlenecks, evaluation delays, and non-compliance.
gen_risks.mitigation: Establish a dedicated PMU in ADISA staffed with qualified procurement and financial management specialists, backed by intensive World Bank training and POM guidelines.
gen_risks.evidence: Neither MIPA, nor the recently constituted ADISA have previous experience in implementation of large donor funded operations... procurement risk rating is high.

gen_risks.description: The reform program's highly compressed implementation timeline across dozens of agencies risks slippage in business process re-engineering and DLI achievement.
gen_risks.mitigation: Sequence project interventions to secure early quick wins while utilizing results-based financing (DLIs) to incentivize key structural milestones through 2020.
gen_risks.evidence: The Government’s timeline for the reform is very ambitious... The compressed implementation timeline is a potential risk

gen_risks.description: Institutional resistance and reluctance from line agency personnel and field staff to cede front-office service functions to ADISA could delay implementation.
gen_risks.mitigation: Deploy structured change management programs, stakeholder outreach, and strategic oversight through the Prime Minister-led Inter-Ministerial Public Services Committee.
gen_risks.evidence: Institutional reforms can be expected to be met with caution at the agency level, if not opposition... field level staff is likely to resist.

gen_risks.description: Over-focusing on centralized high-end citizen service centers and online e-services risks excluding poor, rural, elderly, and minority populations with low digital literacy.
gen_risks.mitigation: Provide assisted internet access points, retain upgraded regional service counters, and execute targeted outreach campaigns using community and grassroots organizations.
gen_risks.evidence: There is a risk that the focus on state-of-the-art means for service delivery... will diminish access of the poor and vulnerable

gen_risks.description: Construction of the new Citizen Service Center building in Tirana could generate localized environmental hazards including noise, dust, waste generation, and traffic congestion.
gen_risks.mitigation: Incorporate the site-specific Environmental Management Plan (EMP) into construction contracts and enforce strict monitoring of construction practices and permits.
gen_risks.evidence: Potential environmental impacts that are associated with new construction include dust and noise, waste generation, material supply, use of machinery on site

gen_risks.description: Inadequate internal controls and manual payroll systems across participating agencies create financial management risks regarding accurate tracking of Eligible Expenditure Programs.
gen_risks.mitigation: Procure customized accounting software for the PMU, deploy experienced FM specialists, and require regular financial reporting and Supreme Audit Institution external audits.
gen_risks.evidence: The overall financial management risk is rated as Substantial... payroll systems remain by and large manual systems

gen_risks.description: The client's limited experience with Results-Based Financing (RBF) modalities and DLI verification protocols could result in disbursement delays.
gen_risks.mitigation: Provide targeted technical assistance, establish clear verification protocols, and maintain continuous hands-on guidance from World Bank country office staff.
gen_risks.evidence: GoA has limited experience with results-based lending. As a result, the counterpart requires targeted support

gen_risks.description: Legacy paper registers, missing National ID numbers, and poor data quality across key agencies could impede system interoperability and online automation.
gen_risks.mitigation: Provide technical assistance for business process re-engineering, database optimization, software architecture, and integration with the Government Interoperability Platform via NAIS.
gen_risks.evidence: Property and pension records, for example, are only partially digitized... The National ID number is missing for most records

gen_risks.description: Delays or political opposition in passing essential Omnibus legislation through Parliament could postpone the legal elimination of obsolete permits and process reforms.
gen_risks.mitigation: Conduct early legal inventory reviews and maintain strong political drive via the Strategic Planning Committee to ensure timely drafting and passage of legislative packages.
gen_risks.evidence: Reform of government services and repeal of licenses, permits, and approvals will be implemented through omnibus legislation, expected to be passed

gen_risks.description: Unfunded recurring operational costs, software licensing, and ongoing maintenance for the new CSC and IT platforms could threaten post-project financial sustainability.
gen_risks.mitigation: Incorporate comprehensive medium-term budget planning into the approved Reform Policy Document and capture efficiency savings to offset recurring operational expenses.
gen_risks.evidence: Ongoing operating costs are expected to include licenses and system operation and maintenance... cost of such upgrades should also be appropriately factored in.

gen_risks.description: Low public awareness and modest national internet penetration (60%) could lead to low adoption rates of newly established e-services on the e-Albania portal.
gen_risks.mitigation: Launch multi-channel public communications campaigns and offer alternative assisted digital channels at local government desks and internet facilities.
gen_risks.evidence: there will be a need for a physical presence... given modest levels of internet penetration at only 60 internet users per 100 people

gen_risks.description: Inconsistent administrative data reporting and flawed processing time definitions by line agencies could distort M&E tracking and obscure service delays.
gen_risks.mitigation: Establish standardized KPIs across key agencies, cross-validate administrative data using proactive citizen text-message feedback, and perform periodic independent user surveys.
gen_risks.evidence: The data submitted by the IPRO office on the other hand routinely records that almost all applications are processed within the required six days.

gt_risks.description: Institutional capacity poses challenges to delivering the reform effort, despite very high leadership commitment and fast-paced GoA initiation of reforms.
gt_risks.mitigation: The Project Preparation Facility (PPF) is designed to assist capacity building for the implementing agency; the TA part of the loan continues building capacity to deliver, addressing the most pressing capacity needs.

gt_risks.description: Fiduciary risks related to the new form of financial instrument used in Albania.
gt_risks.mitigation: The TA part of the loan helps mitigate the fiduciary risk by supporting fiduciary and budget specialists in the PMU.

gt_risks.description: Technical design risk, named alongside the fiduciary risk as being addressed by the same TA support (fiduciary and budget specialists in the PMU); not separately elaborated beyond this.
gt_risks.mitigation: The TA part of the loan helps mitigate the technical design risk by supporting fiduciary and budget specialists in the PMU.

gt_risks.description: Stakeholder risks arising from inter-agency coordination.
gt_risks.mitigation: Mitigated by strong emphasis on coordination mechanisms in the design of the operation.

gt_risks.description: Bureaucratic resistance to enhanced transparency and simplification of administrative processes.
gt_risks.mitigation: Mitigated in part through high-level leadership and engagement, and through citizen feedback arrangements that help pinpoint poor performance and corruption.

gt_risks.description: Political cycle risk from elections coming up in 2017, which could disrupt reform continuity and government commitment.
gt_risks.mitigation: Mitigated by making early progress in showing results and ensuring a broad constituency of support for the project's objectives and activities among the leadership of participating institutions and service users.
